title: Putnami Storage Resources (manifest)
description: A project's declared object/blob storage resources. Provider-neutral: a deployer maps each resource onto a concrete backend, provisions it, and injects a binding (see putnami-storage-binding.json). The protocol does not proxy object bytes.

resources.description: Object/blob storage resources this project requires.

resourceName.description: Canonical resource identifier: lowercase letters, digits, '-', '_', '.', '/'; 1–64 chars.

access.description: Access level the workload needs; drives the IAM grant scope a deployer provisions. Closed enum; adding a value requires a protocol version bump.

scope.description: Isolation boundary the resource is owned at. Closed enum; adding a value requires a protocol version bump.

signedUrls.description: Whether the workload needs signed-URL capability (clients transfer bytes directly to the provider via time-limited URLs).

public.description: Whether objects need public (unauthenticated) read access.

retention.description: Free-form retention string (e.g. "30d"). Format is deployer-defined.
